tasks.short: Manage backup, security, and user help systems.

steps.what: Run the scheduled backup of help systems
Manage backup, security, and help exceptions
Decide the security exception with the requester
Sign the backup and help exception note

outputs: filed copy of signed exception note v1

tasks.design: The scheduled backup on {DATA_PLATFORM} already runs. That runtime is system work and is not saved human labour. The manager handles backup, security, and help exceptions, signs the note in {DOCS}, and a job files that version. The design does not watch named people.
tasks.previous_blocker: Exception notes were separate from a backup that already ran on its own.
tasks.enabler_now: The existing schedule can keep running. The manager's note can be filed beside it.
tasks.still_hard: A failed backup or a help escalation still needs a person.
tasks.human_edge: The manager decides the exception and any access change.
tasks.altitude: Managing exceptions stays. The backup run was never the manager's time, and only the signed note is filed by a job.

reach.learn: That the backup runtime is not their saved time either

evidence.claim: The management digest says security and IT work uses ticket and incident-log configuration, and judgement stays manual.
Digest [S14] requires works-council consent for hiring, appraisal, staff data, or monitoring unless a collective agreement settles it, so this design does not add a watch or a score.

assumptions: The backup share is labour_scope system because the job already runs.
unknowns: Who may approve an access exception.
research_questions: Whether every help queue already has an owner.

already_counted.description: Managing exceptions stays inside the remaining time of that step.

incremental.description: Remap ticket or ledger fields when the record layout changes, and clear exceptions the job cannot file.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: The scheduled backup already runs and is excluded from human time. Only filing the signed exception note moves, after a small upkeep allowance.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: The information systems manager spends the week on priorities, people, and the signed decision. Ticket totals and filing a signed note move to a job. A backup that already runs is not saved labour.
reach: Service desk leads receive a signed priority list instead of a verbal shuffle.
Analysts see the assignment the manager signed, not a score.
skills_to_grow: Reject a report figure that has no ticket or ledger row.
Keep hiring, assignment, and access changes as their own decision.
role.ambitious_version: A signed priority list can open the week's work board, and the manager still releases it.
